"""Regression tests for boltons.strutils.ordinalize.

Covers the ordinal-suffix rules for teens (11-13) and numbers ending in
the twenties (20-29), plus the pre-existing string and ext_only behavior.
"""

import unittest

import pytest

from boltons.strutils import ordinalize


def test_basic_suffixes():
    assert ordinalize(1) == '1st'
    assert ordinalize(2) == '2nd'
    assert ordinalize(3) == '3rd'
    assert ordinalize(4) == '4th'
    assert ordinalize(5) == '5th'
    assert ordinalize(9) == '9th'
    assert ordinalize(10) == '10th'


def test_teens_use_th():
    assert ordinalize(11) == '11th'
    assert ordinalize(12) == '12th'
    assert ordinalize(13) == '13th'
    assert ordinalize(14) == '14th'
    # teens embedded in larger numbers also take 'th'
    assert ordinalize(111) == '111th'
    assert ordinalize(112) == '112th'
    assert ordinalize(113) == '113th'
    assert ordinalize(1011) == '1011th'
    assert ordinalize(2413) == '2413th'


def test_twenties_use_last_digit():
    assert ordinalize(20) == '20th'
    assert ordinalize(21) == '21st'
    assert ordinalize(22) == '22nd'
    assert ordinalize(23) == '23rd'
    assert ordinalize(24) == '24th'
    assert ordinalize(29) == '29th'
    # twenties embedded in larger numbers
    assert ordinalize(121) == '121st'
    assert ordinalize(122) == '122nd'
    assert ordinalize(123) == '123rd'
    assert ordinalize(1520) == '1520th'


def test_large_and_misc_numbers():
    assert ordinalize(100) == '100th'
    assert ordinalize(1000) == '1000th'
    assert ordinalize(1515) == '1515th'
    assert ordinalize(3694839230) == '3694839230th'
    assert ordinalize(-1) == '-1st'
    assert ordinalize(-11) == '-11th'
    assert ordinalize(-22) == '-22nd'


def test_string_input():
    assert ordinalize('1') == '1st'
    assert ordinalize('11') == '11th'
    assert ordinalize('22') == '22nd'
    # strings not ending in a digit are returned unchanged
    assert ordinalize('hi') == 'hi'
    assert ordinalize('') == ''
    assert ordinalize('42nd') == '42nd'


def test_ext_only():
    assert ordinalize(1, ext_only=True) == 'st'
    assert ordinalize(2, ext_only=True) == 'nd'
    assert ordinalize(3, ext_only=True) == 'rd'
    assert ordinalize(4, ext_only=True) == 'th'
    assert ordinalize(11, ext_only=True) == 'th'
    assert ordinalize(12, ext_only=True) == 'th'
    assert ordinalize(13, ext_only=True) == 'th'
    assert ordinalize(22, ext_only=True) == 'nd'
    assert ordinalize('hi', ext_only=True) == ''


class TestOrdinalizeUnittest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_teens(self):
        for number, expected in ((11, '11th'), (12, '12th'), (13, '13th')):
            self.assertEqual(ordinalize(number), expected)
            self.assertEqual(ordinalize(number, ext_only=True), 'th')

    def test_twenties(self):
        for number, expected in ((21, '21st'), (22, '22nd'), (23, '23rd'),
                                 (24, '24th'), (20, '20th')):
            self.assertEqual(ordinalize(number), expected)

    def test_ext_only_twenties(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(21, ext_only=True), 'st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(22, ext_only=True), 'nd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(23, ext_only=True), 'rd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(24, ext_only=True), 'th')

    def test_non_digit_string_preserved(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('hi'), 'hi')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('hi', ext_only=True), '')
